AI Overview
Color Rush is a fast-paced browser-based autorunner and parkour game where your character runs forward automatically while you jump and switch colors to match the platforms below. 
Color Rush Game
 +3
How to Play
Objective: Guide your character across multicolored tracks, leap over gaps, and switch your color to match the ground before landing.
Instant Failure: If your character's color does not match the platform upon landing—or if you touch black hazards—the run ends immediately and you restart the level.
Progression: Collect items and complete level goals to unlock new worlds with higher speeds and tougher layouts.
Where to Play: You can play for free directly in your web browser through platforms like Color Rush or OzGames with no downloads required. 
Color Rush Game
 +4
Controls
Jump: Press the Up Arrow key or W. Hold it down to adjust jump height and clear wider gaps.
Switch Color: Press the Spacebar (ideally mid-air before landing).
